title: Baby Jag Cottontail and the Deep Dark Sea | Read Along | Luna Story Time
description:
Follow Baby Jag Cottontail, Princess Moon, and Baby Lady into a magical adventure beneath the sea. When borrowed powers slip away, Cottontail discovers what has been hers all along.

Book Two of the Castle Everstair stories. Written with love by Luna and Sunny.

Listen, follow the highlighted words, and enjoy each illustrated page with a gentle piano-and-strings score. Made for little dreamers and the grown-ups reading beside them.
